abstract: Alkyl-lysophospholipids (ALP) inhibited the uptake of [3H]thymidine by cells from a variety of human urologic tumors in vitro. Cells of prostate carcinomas, a seminoma, various bladder carcinomas and teratocarcinomas showed proliferation rates that were 10% of those of the controls when incubated with some ALP for longer than 24 hours. Concentrations as low as 1 microgram ALP/ml medium (10(6) tumor cells) were effective. Antitumor action increased after incubation for 2-5 days. Morphologic studies showed tumor cell death after incubation periods of this length. Equivalent concentrations of conventional cytostatic drugs used in anticancer chemotherapy protocols did not cause greater inhibition of [3H]thymidine uptake by tumor cells in vitro. Human embryonic fibroblasts were not sensitive to ALP, whereas cytostatic drugs completely inhibited their proliferation at comparable doses.
abstract_ja: ALP（アルキルリゾリン脂質）は、ヒト尿路系腫瘍由来細胞における[3H]チミジン取り込みを in vitro で阻害した。前立腺癌、セミノーマ、膀胱癌、奇形癌の細胞は、長時間の曝露により対照の約10%の増殖率を示した。曝露期間が2～5日に延びると抗腫瘍作用は増強した。形態学的検討では、この期間の曝露後に腫瘍細胞の死が認められた。同等濃度の従来の抗がん化学療法薬は、より強い抑制を示さなかった。ヒト胎児線維芽細胞はALPに感受性を示さず、一方で細胞増殖剤は完全に増殖を抑制した。
